name: Binbou Gakuen Rikujoubu
source:
Notable people in the town are having a party at an inn.
Then the director and vice president of the local school's women's track and field club appear.
The girls, who are suffering from financial difficulties, say they want to earn money for their club expenses...

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ146822.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
镇上的名人们正在旅馆举办聚会。
这时，当地学校女子田径部的部长和副部长出现了。
饱受经济困难的女孩们说，她们想为社团经费赚些钱……
